early_findings.description: Tuple/list representation of in-memory worlds versus serialized accounting differed; compare complete canonical dictionaries without dropping fields.

An added guard initially expected float64 source observations. Actual adapter captures are float32; owner one setup error and independent seven setup errors occurred before mutation attacks. Guard fixed to actual dtype; final suite covers source/logit metadata attacks.
Strengthened independent certificate source/count/volume/flags; recheck all frozen inputs after candidate export before final authority. No earlier failing public execution asserted.

The initial launcher-timeout test replaced subprocess.Popen broadly and intercepted platform uname. The mock was restricted to the worker command; this was a test-only setup defect, not a production timeout failure.
